name: Miller Scales & Food Machines
old_description: Miller Scales & Food Machines has provided goods and services to the butcher and meat processing industry since 1960. We have a proven track record for quality service and competitive sales offerings. Whether you are in need of seasonings, packing supplies, or food equipment, we are here to assist.
about:
Miller Scales & Food Machines has operated from Fort Wayne, Indiana since 1960. The company began as a supplier to the butcher and meat processing trade, though the founding family or individuals are not identified in public records.

The business combines product distribution with hands-on technical support. Its product line includes seasonings, packaging supplies, and food-processing equipment from brands such as Biro, Ishida, Rice Lake Weighing Systems, and Kentmaster. A fully staffed service department performs on-site and in-house repairs, grinder-plate and knife sharpening, scale programming, and custom seasoning blending. A route-truck program delivers supplies to customers in the region.

Customers are primarily butcher shops, meat processors, and related food-service operations. The company maintains memberships in the American Association of Meat Processors, the Indiana Meat Packers and Processors Association, the Michigan Meat Association, and the Ohio Association of Meat Processors, indicating a focus on the Midwest and Great Lakes meat trade.

The company emphasizes its long-standing reputation for quality service and competitive pricing as its differentiator.
